title: Two Approximate Solutions of the Ornstein-Zernike (OZ) Integral Equation
summary: This thesis explores the evolution of liquid-state theories based on the Ornstein-Zernike (OZ) equation, summarizing the foundational methods developed by Baxter, Lebowitz, Wertheim, and others. A unifying feature of these approaches is their shared analytical strategy: by introducing an intermediate function with specific mathematical properties, they effectively decouple the total correlation function and the direct correlation function.
